boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Puget Sound
boards.description: Ten currently documented food stops in Tacoma for late-hour pickup, drive-thru, or dining; confirm the service mode before leaving.

cards.title: Jack in the Box on 6th Avenue
cards.subtitle: 2054 6th Ave, Tacoma, WA 98403
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when arriving after the lobby closes. The official location page lists drive-thru service until 3 a.m. every day.
cards.short_summary: A 6th Avenue fast-food stop with late drive-thru service.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2054 6th Ave location lists drive-thru hours from 4 a.m. to 3 a.m. daily; its lobby closes at 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 2054 6th Ave, Tacoma
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: 4 a.m.–3 a.m. daily. Lobby: 6 a.m.–10 p.m.; late access is drive-thru only.

cards.title: Taco Bell on North Pearl Street
cards.subtitle: 2615 North Pearl St, Tacoma, WA 98406
cards.notes: Plan this as a drive-thru stop late at night. The official page lists 2 a.m. closing most nights and 4 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: North Pearl drive-thru with later weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2615 North Pearl Street Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and until 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 2615 North Pearl Street, Tacoma
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru closes at 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Dine-in hours end earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on 6th Avenue
cards.subtitle: 2902 6th Ave, Tacoma, WA 98406
cards.notes: Check the location page before departing, then use the drive-thru for a late food purchase. The Tacoma locator currently marks this site Open Late until 4 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A 6th Avenue Taco Bell listed as open late.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s Tacoma location finder lists the 2902 6th Avenue restaurant as Open Late and open until 4 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The official Tacoma locator currently shows this location open until 4 a.m.; verify the day’s service details before travel.

cards.title: IHOP on South Union Avenue
cards.subtitle: 2323 S Union Ave, Tacoma, WA 98405
cards.notes: Reserve this option for Friday or Saturday night. The official page lists midnight closing on those nights and confirms dine-in, takeout, and delivery.
cards.short_summary: A dine-in pancake option with midnight weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP at 2323 S Union Ave lists Friday and Saturday hours of 6 a.m. to 12 a.m. and offers dine-in, online ordering, takeout, and delivery.
cards.access_notes: Open until 12 a.m. Friday and Saturday; closes earlier on other nights. Dine-in, takeout, and delivery are listed.

cards.title: Burritos California on South 38th Street
cards.subtitle: 820 S 38th St, Tacoma, WA 98418
cards.notes: Use the Tacoma location selector when ordering. Its official ordering page identifies the South 38th Street site and lists round-the-clock hours.
cards.short_summary: A Tacoma burrito counter with 24-hour listed service.
cards.evidence_claim: Burritos California’s official locations page identifies its Tacoma restaurant at 820 S 38th St and lists business hours as open 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: The official locations page lists the Tacoma address and open-24-hours service daily; hours may vary by location.

cards.title: Denny’s on Pacific Avenue South
cards.subtitle: 10802 Pacific Ave S, Tacoma, WA 98444
cards.notes: Choose this diner when you need a seated meal at an uncommon hour. Its official location page lists restaurant service open 24 hours and walk-ins welcome.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Tacoma diner with all-day breakfast.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s at 10802 Pacific Ave South lists restaurant hours as open 24 hours and lists round-the-clock breakfast, lunch and dinner, and walk-ins.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours are listed as open 24 hours daily; walk-ins welcome.

cards.title: Subway at Tacoma Place Shopping Center
cards.subtitle: 1901 S 72nd St, Suite A-37, Tacoma, WA 98408
cards.notes: Open the official store page before going and use its pickup or delivery links. It lists the Tacoma Place Shopping Center restaurant as open 24 hours daily.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour sandwich stop in Tacoma Place Shopping Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Subway’s official page for 1901 S 72nd Street lists store hours as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday and offers pickup and delivery.
cards.access_notes: Store hours are listed as open 24 hours every day; pickup and delivery are available.

cards.title: McDonald’s on South Tacoma Way
cards.subtitle: 10417 S Tacoma Way, Tacoma, WA 98499
cards.notes: For overnight access, use the drive-thru rather than assuming the dining room is open. The official page lists a 24-hour drive-thru and an 11 p.m. lobby close.
cards.short_summary: A South Tacoma Way drive-thru that operates overnight.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s at 10417 S Tacoma Way lists drive-thru hours as 24 hours daily and restaurant/lobby hours from 5 a.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is open 24 hours daily. Lobby hours are 5 a.m.–11 p.m., so late access is drive-thru only.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box, 5517 Pacific Ave
cards.title: Jack in the Box on Pacific Avenue
cards.subtitle: 5517 Pacific Ave, Tacoma, WA 98408
cards.notes: Use this as a drive-thru stop after the lobby closes. The official location page lists drive-thru service until 3 a.m. every day.
cards.short_summary: A Pacific Avenue fast-food option with late drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Jack in the Box at 5517 Pacific Ave lists drive-thru hours from 4 a.m. to 3 a.m. daily and lobby hours until 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 5517 Pacific Ave, Tacoma
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: 4 a.m.–3 a.m. daily. Lobby: 6 a.m.–10 p.m.; late access is drive-thru only.

cards.title: Taco Bell on East 72nd Street
cards.subtitle: 1404 E 72nd St, Tacoma, WA 98404
cards.notes: Plan for the drive-thru after dine-in closes. The official page lists this East 72nd Street Taco Bell’s drive-thru as open until 4 a.m. every day.
cards.short_summary: An East Tacoma drive-thru with 4 a.m. listed closing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell at 1404 E 72nd Street lists drive-thru hours from 7 a.m. to 4 a.m. every day, while dine-in closes at 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: 7 a.m.–4 a.m. daily. Dine-in ends at 10 p.m.; use the drive-thru for late access.
